title: Centered Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $f:G\to\mathbb{C}$, and let $\chi:G\to\mathbb{C}$ be an additive character. The Fourier coefficient of $f$ after subtracting its uniform mean is zero when $\chi$ is the trivial character, and otherwise equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\chi$.
